title: Variance of a sign-valued random variable
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $f:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$ take only the values $-1$ and $1$. Then the expectation of the squared deviation of $f$ from its mean is four times the product of the probabilities that $f$ equals $1$ and $-1$: $\mathbb{E}_{\pi}[(f-\mathbb{E}_{\pi}f)^2]=4\,\mathbb{P}_{\pi}(f=1)\,\mathbb{P}_{\pi}(f=-1)$.
